ASCII Table Reference

Full ASCII table 0–127: decimal, hex, octal, character, control-code names and HTML entities — searchable.

📖 How to use

  1. Browse the full 0–127 ASCII table.
  2. Type in the search box to filter by code, character or name.
  3. Click Copy on any row to copy its decimal code.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which codes are covered?

The table covers all 128 ASCII codes: 0–31 and 127 are control codes (shown by name), 32–126 are printable characters.

How do I search?

Type a decimal, hex value, character or control name (e.g. 65, 0x41, A, or NUL) to filter the table.

What are the HTML entity columns for?

HTML entities like &amp; let you safely write special characters in HTML source.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
